title: Unauthorized
description: Tarkov in Minecraft! Grind through quest lines or just PvP
body:
**Unauthorized** is an **extraction-type** server with **three main quest lines**.
Lots of content to do on the side, main focus being fetch quests and PvP though.
_Basically Tarkov in Minecraft!_ **Events every Friday and Saturday 4PM EST. 0 P2W!**
